scope: Supplementary renderer states: 21 common result/error cases and 25 auxiliary cases. These 46 drawings are separate from the 101 card template states in card-ui-paper-baseline.json.
data_provenance: Current application renderer modules with deterministic synthetic QA fixtures. No account profile, credentials or real conversation contents are included. Baseline captures precede UI improvements and are not live questionnaire evidence.
evidence_location: .omc/artifacts/card-ui-audit (local ignored audit artifacts; paths below are relative to this directory)
limitations: Source comparison statuses and notes are transcribed from the canonical author review receipts. This index check verifies counts, identities, evidence existence and live Paper inventory; it is not a new independent visual review of every drawing.
Paper drawings use editable elements. Native scrollbar chrome is omitted where recorded; long interior scroll regions in settings/model and natural backtest cases are expanded to show all content.
Source file hashes recorded after capture do not prove the exact code bytes at capture time. See source-hash-manifest.json for capture and recording timestamps.
The baseline timeline drawing intentionally retains the old raw-tree output. The new timeline renderer belongs to the separate improvement evidence.
2026-10-01 사용자 요청 이후 natural-form/natural-result/natural-error 3개는 codex/laya-experiments-20261001 브랜치의 참고 도면이다. 이 파일의 46개 기준선과 원본 검증 기록은 분리 전 상태를 보존한다.
